`prototype-production.json` contains the unrounded outputs of the existing
`BuildingObjects::get()` production closures for levels 1–8, average temperature
40 °C and Energy Technology 0. It was generated by bootstrapping Laravel and
calling the original PHP closures, with Mockery planet/player service instances.
`Economy.test.mjs` compares the JavaScript mine and energy calculation against
these PHP values, including the server's slot-bonus and rounding rules.

The fixture covers base formulas only. Class/officer/item/crawler/plasma bonuses
are excluded from version 0.13. Do not refresh it from the JavaScript code.
